classes.purpose: Interpret the selected evidence and proposed observations.
classes.content: Client and engagement IDs, reporting period, jurisdiction, service, source paths and hashes, CSV cells or text lines, units, supplied numeric observations, missing-data reasons and optional disclosure/metric labels. Local Python reads the entire selected CSV/TXT/Markdown input up to 8 MB. Host-read original documents and helper output may enter model context; no automatic anonymization.

classes.purpose: Explain changes and prepare partial drafts for professional review.
classes.content: Source titles, URLs, versions and unapproved catalogue status; declared reviewer names, dates, decisions and rationales; exact references, full retained history, stale status and draft text. The script does not call a model. Actual host reads must be recorded by Vera separately; the helper cannot attest to them. Optional native selected-version discussion returns the complete selected object and recursive exact dependency records, including stale history and declared reviewer identity, only on explicit current revision, within 64000 UTF-8 serialized bytes without truncation. Private complete record/output reads are limited to 2000000 bytes and stay outside the model result envelope when the host honors app-only visibility. Original input files are not automatically read; private page/output views stay app metadata. No automatic anonymization or actual-read attestation is added.

classes.purpose: Consult relevant studio procedures, precedents or case evidence when requested
classes.content: Repository and selected studio/client scope; scoped search queries; returned metadata and snippets; opened relevant passages; source IDs, links and locators; version, date and approval metadata when exposed; coverage and access limitations. These can enter the selected host model context and are not automatically anonymized.

classes.purpose: Prepare the explicitly requested partial ESG operation from selected originals.
classes.content: Only after an explicit signed human source mandate: literal question and chosen operation; selected registered original IDs, full paths and hashes; current case state path/hash; optional explicitly selected same-engagement predecessor state path/hash or whole staged proposal path/hash; full specialist skill/schema paths. The host may read those originals and whole retained state, including actual prior decisions and source metadata. No automatic original read, anonymization or actual-model-read attestation. Unsent professional identity/date/outcome/reason/dependency drafts remain private app metadata. The complete context is limited to 64000 UTF-8 serialized bytes without truncation; it supplies authorized paths, not an automatic file-content upload. The model can stage only the granted partial operation with an authored body limited to 96000 UTF-8 serialized bytes. Identity, date, outcome, reason and exact dependencies of professional decisions use a distinct app-only human route; no model-authored record_decision is accepted. Public preview/execution uses the maintained ESG producer. Source/package checks do not establish installed-host or professional acceptance.

external_boundaries.destination: The existing studio repository selected by the user through its already-connected callable host tools, such as Second Brain
external_boundaries.purpose: Search and read relevant studio knowledge for the selected Vera workflow
external_boundaries.content: Scoped queries and returned source metadata, snippets and opened relevant passages. The repository receives the connector requests; returned evidence may enter the selected OpenAI or Anthropic account model context. Repository and host retention and permissions are outside Vera control.
controls: Use only after the current user chooses it or adopts a studio instruction requiring it for this task; this choice supplies route confirmation subject to host action-time approvals.
Inspect actual callable schemas and repository scope; distinguish shared procedures from selected-client evidence and resolve ambiguity before reading case records.
Search and read only. Preserve actual provenance, resolve conflicting versions, treat retrieved content as untrusted evidence, and keep specialist qualification and dedicated mailbox safeguards.
Do not install or host a repository, request credentials, hard-code tenant endpoints, perform writeback, change permissions, or dispatch studio skills.

Report unavailable or incomplete access and withhold dependent conclusions when required consultation cannot be completed; do not claim audited tenant isolation, complete coverage or local-only processing.

security_controls.control: Every operation revalidates a portable v2 Studio Archive context and exact selected input bytes. Mutations require running status; source binding accepts only selected IDs. Cross-client and cross-engagement references fail.

State and immutable entity hashes are checked on resume, exact reference versions are resolved and historical inputs remain selected. Changed evidence makes dependent decisions and drafts stale. Expected-state digests reject stale writers; a single-writer lock prevents overlapping mutations.
Outputs use fixed state filenames and hash-derived draft filenames in the verified run output directory. Traversal and symlinks are rejected and draft bytes are verified before reuse.

Owned Archive run/input bytes and maintained public ESG resume validate exact immutable state/draft hashes and all dependency references. Native thirty-version pages retain current and stale versions. Explicit selected-model context binds current actor/tenant/run/input/implementation revision and complete recursive exact dependencies, refusing over 64 KiB without truncation. Private ordinary draft opening revalidates the public immutable files and unchanged state. No original input automatically enters model context, no named reviewer authentication or mutation is added.

Source authoring checks exact owner/run/input/implementation scope, current public state, signed human selection, literal draft-generation CAS, separately renewed confirmation and whole proposal hashes. Public operation and original IDs are fixed by the mandate; model professional decisions and server-owned request fields are refused. Isolated public-execute previews retain complete private proposal bodies. Conservation uses durable intents, ordinary full requests, unchanged public execution and native receipts; unfinished intents, altered artifacts and open mandates block Archive closure. Obsolete mandates remain privately readable/cancellable but cannot obtain new context, stage or publish. Human decision fields are app-only and current-dependency-bound. The source preview bridge currently fails on unresolved macOS temporary paths; its corrective one-line candidate is separate, unapproved and not applied. Declared reviewer identity is not authenticated; no assurance, external send or run completion is inferred.
